sections.section: Preparation (disposable relationship CM-REVIEW-20261026-01 Accept-7 from guide 01)
sections.note: All through the UI. QA got Collaborate (technician) staff access. A new MSP SLA policy 'CM-REVIEW-20261026-10 MSP policy' was created (P1 - Critical, response 1 hour) and applied to the disposable client. The 5 customer priorities were mapped to P1 - Critical; escalation is refused without both, and Oz has no default SLA policy. The customer created native ticket '... 864549 shared ticket' and escalated it to the MSP. QA posted a Shared IT teams comment with a file and a My organization only comment with a file. The customer posted a Private to <org> comment with a file. QA logged 15 commercial minutes (billing_mode commercial, work_item_type co_managed, DRAFT).

Private content was separated in both directions before cutoff, and file SHA-256s were recorded. The archive was opened for a baseline (10 evidence rows, 0 manifests). No invoice association was prepared.

Review departure > End this relationship? > End relationship > Refresh status showed 'This co-management relationship has ended'. Part 1 then failed its own assertion: after reload, the client's Co-managed IT tab defaults to 'Co-managed IT not enabled' with a Relationship picker and the setup form. The ended relationship ('Relationship ended', 'Seats released') shows only after picking it, or when coming from the departure link (which now redirects to ...&section=history). The departure itself completed once, so part 2 ('departure-recording-continued') resumed from part 1's receipt instead of ending a second relationship.

Partial within the section. The already-open browser tab check was prepared (10-2-stale-tab-before.png) but never executed: part 1 stopped before it, and the tab cannot be reopened from before the cutoff. Queued notification/mail suppression after cutoff was not run, because it needs an SMTP fault on the shared sink other agents use. The customer can still download its own private file (200).

Retained shared and MSP-private files download with matching SHA-256. Customer-private body and file are absent. Entries show 'QA Tester · Oz', plus the time-recorded entry and the saved work details. A retained-file link fetched by alice@whiterabbit.test (another organization) returned 404. That stands in for 'an unrelated MSP principal': no credentials exist for a second Oz user without assignment. The customer could not make a post-departure local change: the native ticket is read-only (no Add Comment, fields disabled), so 'archive does not track customer change' was only checked against a change that never happened. Observation: each message appears twice in Retained history (live capture plus the at-cutoff archived copy, e.g. private_comment_create and private_comment_archived) with identical labels.

Allocation ad0500f1 was released once with exactly 1 closure row. The sponsor entitlement (simulator subscription sub_774424209, capacity 7) is unchanged and was not cancelled. The commercial time entry 87a05c45 (15 min) survives. Both tenants exist. Invoice/draft continuity was not exercised.

steps: Part 1 (departure-recording): QA gave itself Collaborate access on the disposable client, created and applied an MSP SLA policy, mapped customer priorities
Customer created a native ticket and escalated it to the MSP with a handoff note
QA posted shared + MSP-private comments with files; the customer posted a private comment with a file; QA logged 15 commercial minutes
Baseline: each side's visibility and file bytes; archive baseline
Opened a second MSP tab on the shared ticket; Review departure > End relationship > Refresh status (ended)
Part 2 (departure-recording-continued): reloaded departure link and client tab; picked the ended relationship
Old file links, old shared route, MSP customer queue (all denied or empty); customer native ticket, own file and export page
Archive: retained files compared byte-for-byte; private exclusion; cross-org link probe as Alice; customer local-change attempt (not offered)
Overview, allocation, closure count, time entry and tenants reconciled
outcomes: Relationship e24c064b terminated at 2026-10-26T03:55:18Z (Accept-7 only; White Rabbit and Kansas Farms untouched).
Allocation ad0500f1 released once; pool capacity 7 kept.
Retained archive: shared and MSP-private files intact; customer-private excluded.
The customer workspace keeps its ticket, shared and private content and its own file, but becomes read-only for ticket edits/comments.
limitations: The recording is split in two: part 1 ended the relationship and then failed on the client-view assertion. Part 2 resumes from part 1's receipt. Neither alone covers the whole guide.
Stale already-open tab write check: not run.
Queued notification/mail suppression after cutoff: not run (needs a fault on the shared SMTP sink).
No unrelated Oz MSP principal credentials. A different-organization user (Alice) was used for the retained-link probe.

Customer post-departure local change was not possible: the ticket UI is read-only after departure. Duplicate, Create Task, Link to Task, Quick invoice and Delete still look enabled on that read-only ticket; not clicked.
Time entry stayed DRAFT. Approval and invoice/draft continuity across departure were not exercised.
QA sessions were refreshed through the form repeatedly (5-session limit under concurrent agents).
Dry runs left 3 more escalated test tickets ('... 703235', '... 818294', '... 429540'/'523506' partial) in the now-ended relationship; they appear in the archive list.
attempts: attempts/departure-dryrun5 (dry run that reached the time form)
possibleDefects: After departure, /msp/clients/<id>?tab=co-managed defaults to 'Co-managed IT not enabled' plus a setup form. The ended relationship shows only after picking it in the Relationship picker. The guide expects the reloaded client to show the ended relationship. Repro: end a relationship, then open the client's Co-managed IT tab without relationshipId.
Retained history lists each captured message twice with the same label (the capture event and the *_archived event at cutoff). Repro: /msp/co-managed/archive > '... 864549 shared ticket'.
dataLeftBehind: Ended relationship Accept-7 with its tickets/comments/files (kept as departure fixture)
SLA policy 'CM-REVIEW-20261026-10 MSP policy' applied to client CM-REVIEW-20261026-01 Accept-7; 5 priority mappings on the ended relationship
notes: Published recording departure-recording-combined is a lossless concat of departure-recording (part 1) and departure-recording-continued (part 2), composed by the lead for publication.
